solutions.title: Shrink prefix with startsWith
solutions.notes: Start from first word; trim until every string matches
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Take `strs[0]` as the candidate prefix. For each later string, while it does not `startsWith(prefix)`, drop the last character. Stop early if the prefix becomes empty.

**Why preferred:** Short, easy to narrate, and naturally handles “no shared prefix” by shrinking to `''`.

solutions.title: Column scan with every()
solutions.notes: Walk character positions up to the shortest string; stop on first mismatch
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Find the minimum string length, then for each index `position` check that every string has the same character there (`every`). Append matches into an array and `join` at the end; `break` on the first mismatch.

**vs recommended:** Same idea (vertical scan) and very clear. The recommended version mutates one prefix string instead of building an array; both are interview-valid. Drop debug `console.log`s in the helper for real submissions.
